hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Apply filters for pool and room service amenities
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(prior_results=hotels, pool_present=True, has_room_service=True)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Retrieve the latest attraction search results from cache
attractions = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Filter attractions to find the specific one mentioned (Pittock Mansion)
filtered_attractions = filter_attractions(prior_results=attractions, attraction_name=["Pittock Mansion"])

# Save the filtered attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_attractions", value=filtered_attractions)

# Find the nearest attractions to the hotel
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(hotels=filtered_hotels, attractions=filtered_attractions, groupBy="attraction")

# Save the nearest attractions results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

# Output the summary to the user
print("Here are the hotel options in Downtown Portland with a pool and room service:")
for hotel in filtered_hotels.search_results:
    print(f"- {hotel['name']} (Price per night: ${hotel['price_per_night']})")

print("\nHere are the nearest attractions to your hotel:")
for attraction in nearest_attractions.search_results:
    print(f"- {attraction['name']} ({attraction['type']})")
